# Epigraph {.unnumbered .unlisted .oculto}

::: {.epigrafe}
“The machine does not isolate man from the great problems of nature but plunges him more deeply into them.”

 — Antoine de Saint-Exupéry (1939), international airmail pioneer, military reconnaissance pilot and writer, in *Wind, Sand and Stars*.
:::
